title: Mosaic Puzzle
description: Slide the tiles to reveal a procedurally generated mosaic artwork. Multiple grid sizes, two game modes, and a new mosaic every game.
detailedDescription: A sliding tile puzzle where every game presents a fresh mosaic generated from procedural patterns. Choose from 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 grids, then slide tiles into the empty space to reconstruct the original artwork. Two modes are available: Classic mode shows the full image as a reference, while Challenge mode requires you to solve from memory after a brief preview. The procedural generation creates vibrant geometric mosaics inspired by stained glass, Islamic geometric art, and modern abstract design. Move counter tracks your efficiency.
controls: Click a tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it. Use arrow keys as an alternative. Complete the mosaic to win.
